        Exploited now · outages · orbits · الثغرات المستغلة والانقطاعات والمدارات

          USGS and Open-Meteo load straight in the browser. OpenSky, GDACS, GDELT, Digitraffic AIS and the NGA Maritime Safety Information broadcast warnings need the local proxy (start-omega or node scripts/omega-data-proxy.mjs), because they send no CORS headers or have tight anonymous limits. Each NGA warning is sorted into Hormuz, Bab el-Mandeb, Suez, Malacca or Panama by the position in its text or by name. Live ship positions are free only for the Baltic (Digitraffic), so the straits show official warnings and headlines, not ship counts. SAT shows NASA GIBS Blue Marble imagery and falls back to the drawn map when offline. Satellites come from CelesTrak mean elements and are placed by two-body motion with J2 drift (not SGP4, so a low orbit can be tens of km off). Submarine cables are drawn as approximate hand-drawn corridors through the main chokepoints, not real cable routes: TeleGeography's route data is licensed, see submarinecablemap.com. CISA KEV and IODA need the local proxy or the hourly snapshot. The cyber storm radar adds the SANS ISC InfoCON level, Shodan InternetDB records of four public resolvers (a lookup of Shodan's weekly data, never a scan), the RIS Live BGP stream for their anycast prefixes and adsb.lol emergency squawks and aircraft around the straits (ODbL); NASA GIBS draws night lights and the day's thermal anomalies over the flat map. Ships with AIS switched off would need radar (SAR) imagery, which has no keyless source, so that row says NO FREE SOURCE. · المضائق تعرض الإنذارات الملاحية الرسمية من NGA وأخبار GDELT مع المصدر والتاريخ.

                        Links are the ones the desk uses. Filaments fire only on a microprice move of 0.5 bps or more, a new whale wall or iceberg, a new data pull, or your hover and tap. Gamma assumes dealers are long calls and short puts, which is a public convention, not observed positioning.                           Local model through Ollama, optional · النموذج المحلي عبر أولاما [INFERENCE - local LLM]

                          Works when this page is opened from start-omega (127.0.0.1:8796) and Ollama runs on the same computer. GLM-5.2 exists only as a cloud model in Ollama (glm-5.2:cloud), so the bridge refuses it; a local GLM such as glm4 (9B, about 5.5 GB) or glm-4.7-flash (about 19 GB) is used. The model only explains the readings in the table on the left; it cannot trade or move money. · يشرح القراءات فقط ولا ينفذ أي صفقة.

                          All 139 inputs, their sources and values · كل المدخلات ومصادرها

                          Continuous time (ADR-110): every hidden and decision neuron follows its input as dx/dt = (σ(Wx + b) − x) / τ, solved with Heun steps, so a change at the inputs reaches the heads after a delay that grows with depth. τ shortens up to eightfold after a shock (a whale wall, a microprice move of 0.5 bps or more, a BGP origin change, an emergency squawk, a higher InfoCON) and relaxes over about 30 seconds; at rest every neuron sits on the trained answer. A small network of 11,792 weights trained in this browser on the last 300 readings of real public data. Head 1 learns the next 30 seconds of the Binance microprice; heads 2 to 8 learn to reproduce the desk's own rule values (half-Kelly size, target, stop, circuit breaker, locked-base recovery, profit sweep, court confidence), so you can see how the data flows into them. The rules, the risk judge and the receipt chain decide; the network opens nothing and the $20 locked base must be whole before any sweep, whatever it says. Missing sources enter as 0 and show as hollow neurons. Threads move only on a microprice move of 0.5 bps or more, a new reading, a data pull or your touch, and stay still during the self-test and under reduced motion. Decision aid for paper trading only. · أداة مساعدة للتداول الورقي فقط، القواعد هي التي تقرر ولا يُرسل أي أمر.

                            Court and engine · المحكمة والمحرك الورقي

                            Every line is a link the code really has. A teaching line runs from a desk rule to the head that learns its value, and its colour is the gap between the two: green within 0.25, amber up to 0.6, red beyond, grey with no reading. The network's heads never feed the court, the engine or the vault: the risk judge rules, the paper auto engine opens only on its OPEN, and every paper move gets a SHA-256 receipt. The Brain 2 gym agents inform the synaptic web only. Paper trading only; nothing is sent to any exchange. · كل خط رابط حقيقي في الكود. الشبكة لا تقرر ولا تفتح صفقة؛ القاضي يقرر والمحرك ورقي فقط.

                            PRIME · lead agent, nine helpers and their operating systemالوكيل الخارق ومساعدوه ونظام تشغيله
                            PAUSED

                            One lead agent and nine helpers, each with one task and its own tools. Every 15 seconds while this tab is open it scans twelve markets, reads the desk's hourly candles and order flow, watches OSIRIS, checks the risk gate, steers the paper desk and re-audits the receipts. Paper only: it never signs or sends an order, and the desk's auto engine still opens a paper trade only on the risk judge's OPEN. · ورقي فقط: لا يوقّع ولا يرسل أي أمر، والقاضي هو اللي يقرر كل دخول.

                                Open-source projects the design draws on, ideas only · مكتبة الأدوات المفتوحة

                                Licences as each repository publishes them; nothing here is installed or run. Installing any of them needs Ahmad's approval and a written security review (AGENTS.md §1).

                                Scores are fixed rules on public numbers, not predictions: the scout weighs the 24 h change as a z-score across the list and the position in the day's range, scaled by volume rank; the analyst weighs EMA 20 against EMA 50, Wilder RSI 14 and Bollinger %b. The executor moves the desk to another of its four markets only when that market leads by 0.25 for three cycles in a row, no paper position is open and 30 minutes have passed since the last move. The risk gate stops the autopilot on an emergency stop, a broken receipt chain, a paper balance 10% under the locked base, or when the auto engine is switched off by hand. The loop stops when the tab closes or the computer sleeps, and resumes when the page opens again. · قواعد ثابتة وليست تنبؤاً، والطيار الآلي يتوقف عند أي خطر.

                                  Receipt chain · SHA-256سلسلة الفواتير الموثقة
                                  0

                                  Every deposit, lock, fill, sweep, withdrawal and emergency stop issues a receipt. Each hash covers the receipt and the previous hash, so changing or deleting any old receipt breaks every hash after it. Past 1000 receipts the oldest 500 fold into one Merkle checkpoint so storage never fills; export the chain first if you need every line. · كل فاتورة مربوطة ببصمة السابقة، والقديمة تُضغط في نقطة تحقق Merkle.

                                  📦 Encrypted account capsuleكبسولة الحساب المشفرة بين اللابتوب والآيفون
                                  AES-GCM 256 · NO SERVER

                                  Export the paper wallet (locked base, safe vault), the full SHA-256 receipt chain, the court's learned weights and your notes.md as one encrypted .omega-capsule.json file. Send it to the other device any way you like (AirDrop, cable, USB) and import it there with the same passphrase. The receipt chain is verified before anything is replaced. No API key or vault secret goes in a capsule. · لا يمر الملف بأي سيرفر، والتشفير يتم داخل المتصفح.
